column2: Another Skill
Skills come at even Levels.
A Command token and a new visible Level token
You can command one more Unit, and the revealed token shows your new Armor and Hand Limit values.
From one Round to the next
Three players chose Tactics 5, 2 and 4. Who goes first?
The 5
The lowest number goes first.
The 2
Turn Order follows ascending numbers: 2, 4, then 5.
Later. At the start of your turn, your Deck is empty; you hold Rage and a Wound.
I must announce the end of the Round
Only if your hand is empty too.
I have a choice: announce, or play a turn
Empty deck with cards in hand: the decision is yours.
I reshuffle my discard pile
Never before the end of the Round.
You announce the end of the Round.
I still play my turn
The announcement replaces your turn.
Each other player plays one last turn, then the Round stops
You don't even benefit from the space you are on.
New Round. Your Peasants were Spent and Wounded. What state are they in?
Ready and healed
Wounds don't disappear on their own.
Ready, but still Wounded
They get their Command token back but can only act once healed.
And the Wound you had in hand?
It is reshuffled into your Deck
All your cards, Wounds included, form the Deck again.
Only Healing removes a Wound.
A Monastery, two ways
You are in a Monastery with 8 Influence and a Wound in hand. What can you buy?
The Advanced Action (6) and one Healing point (2)
Several purchases in one interaction, as long as the Influence is enough.
The Advanced Action and two Healing points
That would be 10 Influence.
A Spell for 7
Spells are bought at a Mage Tower or the Blue City.
Another day, you decide to burn this Monastery. What happens to your Reputation?
That is the cost of an assault or a plunder.
−3, right away
The loss is immediate, whatever the outcome of the combat.
You draw a purple enemy. Your two Units are Ready.
They fight normally
They refuse to take part in this act.
They don't take part: no activation, no Damage for them
You fight alone.
You win. Your reward?
An Artifact: at the end of the turn, I draw two and keep one
And the Monastery no longer exists for the rest of the game.
A Spell from the Offer
That is the reward of a Mage Tower.
The Monster Den and its reward
A Monster Den is on your path. You can…
only stop and fight
An adventure site can always be ignored.
cross it, stop there without fighting, or enter: that will be your action
Entering the Monster Den is the action for the turn.
You enter and fail against the brown monster. What happens to its token?
The next Hero who enters will face the same monster.
It is discarded
That is the case for the Dungeon, not the Monster Den.
Next turn, victory. At the end of the turn, you roll two dice for the reward:
. What do you gain?
+1 Fame
a Crystal of the colour of my choice
a Crystal
Basic colour: that Crystal. Gold: colour of your choice. Black: 1 Fame instead.
Two Crystals of my choice
The die decides the colour, except on a gold result.
Nothing: I had to win the first time
The reward goes to whoever conquers the site, however many attempts it took.
Taking a City
You attack a Red City. A defender with physical Attack 4 isn't blocked. How much Damage does it deal?
In the Red City, the defenders' physical attacks become Brutal.
Brutal doubles the Attack when dealing Damage.
You defeat 2 of the 3 defenders.
The City is mine
You must defeat all the defenders.
I place 2 Shield tokens on the City card and fall back
One Shield per defeated defender, and back to the space you came from.
Another player defeats the last defender. Who becomes Lord of the City?
Them: they struck the final blow
Only the number of Shield tokens counts.
Me: 2 Shields against 1
If tied, it would be the first to have placed a Shield.
You come back to interact in this conquered Red City.
+2 Influence, and Artifacts for 12 Influence
+1 Influence per Shield you placed there.
+1 Influence, and Spells for 7
Spells are bought in the Blue City, and the bonus is +1 per Shield.
A duel, blow by blow
You end your Movement on a rival's space. They decide to participate only partially. Can they take a die from the Source?
That is the privilege of full participation.
No, and their Skills can't be used
In exchange, they keep their next turn.
Ranged and Siege phase. Who attacks first?
Me, the attacker
The attacker opens the Melee phase.
Them, the defender
The roles then swap with each attack.
They make a physical Ranged Attack of 4 against you. You play Block 4. Your Armor is 2.
Everything is blocked
In this phase, you need 2 Block points per Attack point.
2 Damage gets through: they deal me a Wound
Block 4 stops 2. The 2 remaining Damage equal your Armor: one Wound.
4 Damage gets through
Against a player, Block can be partial.
Melee. You deal them 2 unblocked Damage. A free Plains space (cost 2) is adjacent. Their Armor is 3.
I deal them a Wound
It would take 3 Damage, as much as their Armor.
I force them to withdraw onto the Plains: the combat ends and I win
Damage converts into Movement, at the space's cost.
I steal an Artifact from them
That costs 5 Damage.
You are Level 3, they are Level 5. How much Fame do you gain?
Add 2 per Level of difference.
1 point, plus 2 for each of the two Levels between you.
You only gain nothing when you already had more Fame than the loser.
A cooperative assault
You and your partner are each on a space adjacent to a City defended by 4 enemies. On your turn, you propose that each of you face 2. They accept. What do they do?
They flip their Turn Order token: they will skip their next turn
Taking part in the assault costs them their next turn.
Nothing in particular
Their token is flipped to mark the turn they will skip.
How are the 4 defenders split?
Each chooses the two they prefer
Nobody knows in advance who they will face.
They are shuffled and 2 are dealt to each, unseen
You know how many, not which ones.
You defeat your 2 defenders. Your partner only defeats one.
The City is conquered
One defender remains.
The City holds: you both fall back, but your 3 Shields stay on the card
Each defeated defender already counts towards naming the future Lord.
End of the game: you have 60 Fame, your partner 41. What is the basis of the team score?
The player furthest behind is what counts.
Helping your partner progress pays off for the whole team.
Fame isn't added up.
Playing the Dummy
The Dummy owns 2 green Crystals and 1 blue Crystal. On its turn, it discards three cards:
. How many extra cards does it discard?
Only the last card counts: it is
, and it has
of that colour.
Look at the colour of the third card and count its Crystals of that colour.
Next turn:
. How many extra?
The third one is
extra.
Only the colour of the third card counts.
Later, at the start of its turn, its Deck is empty.
It reshuffles its discard pile
Like you, it only reshuffles at the new Round.
It announces the end of the Round: you play one last turn
It is the Dummy that sets the pace of the game.
New Round. The Advanced Action removed from the bottom of the Offer is red, the removed Spell is white.
Both cards go into its Deck
The Spell goes back under its deck.
The Advanced Action joins its Deck, and it gains a white Crystal
Its Deck grows and its Crystals pile up: the Rounds get shorter.
Across the Wall
You challenge these Orcs across a Wall: they are Fortified
A Wall separates you from these Skirmishers. Try your Ranged Attack in the first phase, then win without a Wound.
Wound(s). Block their Attack of 3 first.
In the first phase, the Ranged Attack doesn't hit a Fortified enemy. Block: Determination (2) and March sideways (1). In the Attack phase, everything counts: stronger Swiftness (3) and Rage (2).
Defend
Defend 2: alone, these Protectors protect themselves
These Protectors have the Defend 2 ability. Since they are alone, they apply it to their own Armor. Win without a Wound.
Block: Determination (2) and a sideways card (1). Attack: you need 6, stronger Rage with the red die (4) and the other Rage (2).
Entering a Maze
You are on a Maze with two Ready Units. You have 3 Move points left from your movement, and two Move cards in hand. You are aiming for the 4-point path.
I pay with my 3 remaining points and a sideways card
Leftovers from your Movement phase don't count: you need effects played to enter.
I play my two Move cards to pay 4
Separate Move effects, played when entering.
Who goes inside with you?
My two Units
There is only room for one.
A single Unit, of my choice
The other can neither act nor absorb during this action.
You defeat the monster. What happens to this 4-point path?
It stays open to all
Your Shield closes it.
I mark it with a Shield; I won't come back, but another player can take the 2 or 6 path
Each path is only used once, and each player only enters once.
An Elusive enemy
Shades: Armor 3 or 6, Attack 4. You have a Ranged Attack 4. Do you try it in the first phase?
Yes: 4 against 3
In the Ranged and Siege phase, it is always the higher Armor: 6.
No: it would take 6
Better to keep this card for the Attack phase.
Block phase. You can block their Attack of 4, or let a Unit with Armor 5 absorb it.
The Unit absorbs it: no harm done
Not blocking leaves their Armor at 6 for the whole combat.
I block the 4
All their attacks blocked: their Armor drops to 3 for the Attack phase.
Attack phase. What do you need?
Attack 3, and my Ranged Attack counts
In this phase all Attack types combine, against the low Armor.
Attack 6
You blocked: the low value applies.
Volkare attacks you
Second Day. Volkare enters your space with six tokens. You aren't ready. What does retreating cost?
2 Wounds
That is the rate for the first Day and the first Night.
3 Wounds
2, 3 then 4 Wounds depending on how far the game has gone. You then withdraw to an adjacent safe space.
Nothing, but I skip my turn
Retreating is paid in Wounds.
Later, you face him. His die determines an attack of 5. You don't block it and you have Guardsmen with Armor 5.
The Guardsmen absorb 10 Damage
His attack has Assassination: no Units.
My Hero takes 10 Damage
Brutal, so doubled, and Assassination, so for the Hero alone. Better to block it.
My Hero takes 5 Damage
His attack is also Brutal: unblocked, it doubles.
Two tokens of his army remain. Can you target Volkare himself to finish it?
Yes, with a Siege Attack
Volkare is never a target.
No: he falls when his last two troops fall
Eliminating all his troops is the only way to defeat him.
Ambush and Pursuit
An Ambushing enemy is 2 spaces from you. You move to another space, also 2 spaces from it; the space between you is a Mountain.
It attacks me
The space in between must contain neither mountain nor lake.
It doesn't attack me
Ambush only reaches 2 spaces through a revealed, clear space.
A token is Pursuing you and is 3 spaces away. You finish your Movement.
It moves one space towards me
It even crosses lakes and mountains, as long as the space is revealed and free.
It attacks me right away
It must reach you first.
It only moves if I provoked it
Pursuit is automatic at the end of each Movement of the pursued Hero.
Next turn, it is adjacent and you are in a Village.
It attacks me: that is my action
Not in a place where an interaction is possible.
It can't attack me here
Interaction sites and fortified sites you aren't besieging protect you.
Bringing down a Faction Leader
The Leader is at level 4, Armor 5 at that level, surrounded by two followers. You gather 12 Attack points against it in the Attack phase. What happens?
It loses 1 level
Count the multiples of its Armor.
It loses 2 levels
5 then 10: two Shields placed. It would have taken 15 for a third.
It is defeated
It still has levels left.
The combat ends. What happens to its marker, and are its defeated followers replaced?
The marker drops to level 2; no new followers arrive
Its companions depend on its starting level, once and for all.
The marker drops and two new followers arrive
Enemies are never added when its level drops.
The marker doesn't move before the next Round
It drops at the end of the combat.
You also had a Spell able to destroy an enemy. Does it work on the Leader?
Leaders have Arcane Immunity.
No: only Attacks and Blocks affect it
Arcane Immunity, like Volkare.

Gold die from the Source (Day wildcard)
Pay the mana
with…
A Wound can't be played.
